steps: Submit your inquiry via our commission form at brassnotestudios.com/contact
We schedule a discovery call to learn your story, vision, and requirements
We craft original lyrics and share a draft for your review
You provide feedback — up to 3 revision rounds are included
We produce the full arrangement and deliver broadcast-ready audio files
You receive full commercial rights to your commissioned work
process.turnaround: Typical delivery is 2–4 weeks depending on scope. Rush options available.
process.formats: We deliver WAV and MP3 masters. Stems available upon request.

categories.personal: Birthdays, anniversaries, weddings, memorials, proposals, graduations, and any life milestone you want immortalized in music.
categories.organization: Church anthems, nonprofit mission songs, school fight songs, corporate brand music, event themes.
categories.creator: YouTube intros, podcast themes, Twitch overlays, TikTok originals, music-only beds, lyric videos.
